title: Secret hygiene check
prompt:
Ensure the secret hygiene check (see task 0.11) covers source and logs; add a test that the LOG redaction + scan catch a planted fake key.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Coordinated the two existing secret defences (build-time scanner scripts/secret_scan.py from 0.11; runtime LOG redactor from 1.4) and proved them with one planted fake key. Coverage change: added '.jsonl' to scripts/secret_scan.py SCANNED_SUFFIXES so committed log artifacts (a stray runs/*.jsonl) are scanned too — logs are normally gitignored but the scan must not silently miss one (PRD §7.4 covers source AND logs). Added tests/test_secret_hygiene.py (5 tests). TDD red-first: test_scan_covers_committed_log_artifacts asserted '.jsonl' in SCANNED_SUFFIXES and FAILED (red), then green after the one-line config addition. The tests prove: (a) LOG redaction — log_event with the fake key in payload (api_key + free-text note) → on-disk runs/<run_id>.jsonl OMITS the key and carries the REDACTED marker; (b) Secret scan — the same key in a tmp source .py file AND a tmp runs/*.jsonl is flagged by find_secrets(); (coordination) scan_text() and the redactor both catch the SAME key. The planted FAKE_KEY is assembled from string PARTS at runtime ('sk-' + 'ant-' + 'FAKEKEY' + '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJ') so no sk-ant-… literal is committed to source — the live CI secret-scan gate (which scans committed files) still exits 0. No new constants/patterns duplicated: the test reuses the script's PATTERNS via scan_text/find_secrets and the LOG package's REDACTED marker (single source, §7.2). No external API calls, so the API gatekeeper (Epic 13) is N/A. Gates GREEN: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = 97 files formatted; mypy = no issues in 97 source files; pytest --cov = 372 passed, 100% coverage (Required 85.0% reached); check_line_limit.py exits 0; python scripts/secret_scan.py exits 0 on the tree. The planted key is caught by BOTH redaction and scan and does NOT trip the live CI gate.
